gen-tourney-gf-ramabhadra: Ramabhadra is a plain sans with a prominent x-height, so its text looks generous and sturdy beside the heading. Tourney's wide-tracked, marker-tip letters give it a bold, athletic punch.
gen-tourney-gf-rambla: Every letter in Tourney is cut to a single flat line weight, stretched out with wide tracking and a bulky lowercase. And Rambla handles the quieter work, its sans small letters standing almost as tall as capitals.
gen-tourney-gf-recursive: Recursive reads approachable and modern, with a tall mean line and strokes that keep their thickness in every direction. But Tourney earns its keep when big and short, where its bulky letters and wide tracking can show off.
gen-tourney-gf-roboto-condensed: Contemporary and tight, Roboto Condensed packs its words with barely visible gaps. Its enlarged lowercase is plenty readable even when you size it down a notch, while Tourney keeps the heading loud and athletic.
gen-tourney-gf-saira-semi-condensed: Tourney stretches its bold, athletic letters out with wide tracking and a bulky lowercase. And Saira Semi Condensed follows in modern sans-serif, its text looking magnified while holding a steady weight from word to word.
gen-tourney-gf-secular-one: Secular One reads modern and sturdy, its dominant midsection swallowing most of the line's height with no modulation at all. Tourney sits above in wide-tracked, athletic letters, a loud sports-jersey start.
gen-tourney-gf-smooch-sans: Tourney hums with a flat, constant line weight, every stroke cut to one width and spread out by wide tracking. Smooch Sans packs its text tightly with a high midline, so a slightly larger size helps.
gen-tourney-gf-sofia-sans-condensed: Tourney's bulky lowercase and wide tracking announce themselves at once. Sofia Sans Condensed, a plain sans with a big x-height and open, unfinished curves, looks friendlier in a size or two up.
gen-tourney-gf-spline-sans-mono: Spline Sans Mono reads technical and precise, its fixed-width monospace letters nearly matching the capitals in height. Nudging it a little larger gives it room beside Tourney's bold, athletic heading.
gen-tourney-gf-tiny5: Tiny5 reads clean and approachable, its sans-serif letters so tall that the ascenders look short. Beside it, Tourney's plain, unshaded lines and wide tracking make the heading the loud, athletic voice.
